title: Contract Pricing Agreement Commitment Attainment Relief on Rebate Forfeiture
content:
## Commitment attainment relief on an early-termination rebate forfeiture — Contract Pricing Agreement

On a Contract Pricing Agreement terminated early, the forfeiture of the termination period's net rebate carries a commitment relief that follows the agreement's commitment attainment. The relief is subtracted from the termination period's net rebate before the forfeiture's floor at 0.00 and its rounding to the cent are applied.

**Commitment attainment.** The qualifying spend on the agreement's rebate accruals dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date, divided by the agreement's annual spend commitment. An agreement with no commitment has an attainment of 0. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

| Commitment attainment | Commitment relief |
|---|---|
| 1.5 or more | 0.3 times the termination period's net rebate |
| At least 1 and below 1.5 | The termination period's net rebate multiplied by the part of the attainment above 1, multiplied by 0.6 |
| Below 1 | No commitment relief |

**Settlement examples (hypothetical net rebate of 1000.00).**
- Attainment 1.6: relief 0.3 times 1000.00, which is 300.00.
- Attainment 1.2: relief 1000.00 multiplied by 0.2 and by 0.6, which is 120.00.
- Attainment exactly 1: the part above 1 is 0, so the relief is 0.00.
- Attainment 0.95: no commitment relief.
